name: io.github.hifriendbot/agentwallet
description: Wallet infrastructure for Ai agents. EVM + Solana. x402 payments. No KYC.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTWALLET_USER
environmentVariables.description: Hosted mode: your hifriendbot.com username

environmentVariables.name: AGENTWALLET_PASS
environmentVariables.description: Hosted mode: an AgentWallet application password from hifriendbot.com/wallet/

environmentVariables.name: AGENTWALLET_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Hosted mode: the API base (default https://hifriendbot.com/wp-json/agentwallet/v1); must be https, or http on localhost

environmentVariables.name: AGENTWALLET_WALLET_ID
environmentVariables.description: Hosted mode: wallet id that pays hosted billing 402s automatically (POST /wallets, /sign, /send only); unset means never

environmentVariables.name: AGENTWALLET_DASHBOARD_URL
environmentVariables.description: Hosted mode: dashboard link shown in tool text

environmentVariables.name: AGENTWALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Local (self-custody) mode: 0x-prefixed EVM private key; signing then happens in this process

environmentVariables.name: AGENTWALLET_KEYFILE
environmentVariables.description: Local mode: path of a file holding the EVM private key (instead of AGENTWALLET_PRIVATE_KEY; not both)

environmentVariables.name: AGENTWALLET_SOLANA_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Local mode for Solana: secret key as a JSON array, base58 or base64

environmentVariables.name: AGENTWALLET_SOLANA_KEYFILE
environmentVariables.description: Local mode for Solana: path of a key file (instead of AGENTWALLET_SOLANA_KEY; not both)

environmentVariables.name: AGENTWALLET_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Local mode: one EVM RPC for every chain

environmentVariables.name: AGENTWALLET_RPC_<chainId>
environmentVariables.description: Local mode: EVM RPC per chain, e.g. AGENTWALLET_RPC_8453; eth_chainId is checked

environmentVariables.name: AGENTWALLET_SOLANA_RPC
environmentVariables.description: Local mode: one Solana RPC for every cluster

environmentVariables.name: AGENTWALLET_SOLANA_RPC_<chainId>
environmentVariables.description: Local mode: Solana RPC per cluster (900 mainnet, 901 devnet, 902 testnet); the genesis hash is checked

environmentVariables.name: AGENTWALLET_CHAIN_ID
environmentVariables.description: Local mode: default EVM chain when a call names none (default 8453)

environmentVariables.name: AGENTWALLET_MAX_TX_NATIVE
environmentVariables.description: Local mode: per-transaction ceiling in native units

environmentVariables.name: AGENTWALLET_MAX_TX_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Local mode: per-transaction ceiling for ERC-20 and SPL transfers and approvals, in token units

environmentVariables.name: AGENTWALLET_MAX_TX_SOL
environmentVariables.description: Local mode: per-transaction ceiling in SOL (also charged for a recipient token account the send creates)

environmentVariables.name: AGENTWALLET_ALLOW_UNKNOWN_TOKEN_CALLS
environmentVariables.description: Local mode: 1 lets calldata the token cap cannot price reach a token contract (refused by default)

environmentVariables.name: AGENTWALLET_TOKEN_DECIMALS
environmentVariables.description: Pin decimals for tokens outside the registry, e.g. 8453:0x<token>=6,<mint>=9; used for amounts and caps instead of the RPC answer

environmentVariables.name: AGENTWALLET_MAX_AUTOPAY
environmentVariables.description: Per-payment x402 ceiling in stablecoin units (default 1); the agent cannot raise it

environmentVariables.name: AGENTWALLET_MAX_AUTOPAY_PER_HOUR
environmentVariables.description: Hosted mode: how many internal 402 auto-payments an hour (default 20; 0 disables)

environmentVariables.name: AGENTWALLET_AUTOPAY_ASSETS
environmentVariables.description: Assets pay_x402 may pay in beyond registry stablecoins, e.g. 8453:native,0x<token>

environmentVariables.name: AGENTWALLET_X402_MAX_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Longest x402 authorization window in seconds (default 3600; 60 to 31536000)

environmentVariables.name: AGENTWALLET_APPROVALS
environmentVariables.description: Hosted mode: 0 disables emailing the wallet owner for an over-cap payment

environmentVariables.name: AGENTWALLET_PERMIT2_AUTO_APPROVE
environmentVariables.description: Hosted mode: 1 approves exactly an upto payment maximum to Permit2 for registry stablecoins

environmentVariables.name: AGENTWALLET_TOKEN_RISK
environmentVariables.description: 0 skips the GoPlus lookup approve_token performs

environmentVariables.name: AGENTWALLET_LEGACY_PAYWALL_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated https origins whose legacy-shaped 402 may be paid by an on-chain transfer proved by hash (the API host always may)

environmentVariables.name: AGENTWALLET_MAX_FEE_NATIVE
environmentVariables.description: Local mode: the most a transaction may burn in fees (gas x max fee per gas), in native units; default 0.01
